newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takeda Chemical profit to exceed 100 bln yen-paper.
newsitem.headline: Takeda Chemical profit to exceed 100 bln yen-paper.

text.p: Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd is expected to report an 11 percent year-on-year increase in parent current profit to 102 billion yen in fiscal 1996/97, the business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported in its evening edition on Monday.
The paper said that this would make Takeda the first Japanese drugs maker to post an annual profit exceeding 100 billion yen.
The company is also expected to post parent sales of 630 billion yen, up five percent from the previous year.
A spokesman for Takeda said he could not confirm the report, but said that sales of its products such as the ulcer drug Takepron and Leuplin have been very strong.
